zahedan: The capital of the Sistan and Baluchestan province of Iran.
zaire: Zaire used to be the name of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The African country called Zaire was renamed in 1997.
zapper: A zapper is a remote control for a television.
Please pass me the zapper, my show is starting on the other channel.
zany: Something or someone that is zany is very weird.
A zany is a weird person.
They got a zany to perform at the party.
zap: A zap is the sound made by a sudden release of electricity.
A zap is an electric shock.
If you zap someone or something, you strike it with electricity.
If you zap someone or something, you destroy it or kill them.
zag: A zag is a sudden or sharp turn or change of direction.
If a person zags, they make such a turn.
zack: It is usually short for Zachary or Zackary.
